63:t_1:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「...So you... Are you saying you fled from $$サイデリアル$$?」

63:t_1:6.en:
$$海賊$$
「The great pirate $$ラケージ$$ is the only boss for us, after all!」

63:t_1:9.en:
$$海賊$$
「W-we... We're ready to risk our lives in your service, $$ラケージ$$!」

63:t_1:12.en:
$$海賊$$
「We're sorry! We're sorry! Please, just spare our lives...!」

63:t_1:13.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I was not referring to you.」

63:t_1:15.en:
$$海賊$$
「D-do you mean $$サイデリアル$$?」

63:t_1:16.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「They displease me too, of course... But the ones who offend me most are them...」

63:t_1:17.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

63:t_1:19.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I've disliked them for some time, but my patience is finally wearing thin.」

63:t_1:20.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「They will learn what happens to those who underestimate us... Whatever secret weapons they have, they are no match for me and my $$ラケージ$$ Pirates.」

63:t_1:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[...I can find no logic in your actions. Explain your reason for maintaining this stalemate.]

63:t_1:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[This unit has sufficient weaponry to defeat or break through the forces currently surrounding us.]

63:t_1:27.en:
$$レド$$
[But if those friendly machines commandeered by the natives, which fought alongside us, surround us, we won't stand a chance.]

63:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
[For now, waiting here for an opportunity is our best option.]

63:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Recommended courses of action. 1. Overwhelm and subdue the surrounding forces. 2. Seize their command center and prevent resistance.]

63:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
[$$チェインバー#pilot$$, our immediate priorities are contacting friendly forces, determining our location...]

63:t_1:31.en:
$$レド$$
[And investigating why $$サイデリアル$$ has deployed forces on this planet at the edge of the galaxy.]

63:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
[If you can't determine our location, we could try looking through their historical records.]

63:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[No... That spacecraft, clearly from a different level of civilization, would be better suited to gathering information.]

63:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
[What matters is that this Earth is a living planet. The Alliance's records say Earth should be a dead world. But this is the reality.]

63:t_1:37.en:
$$レド$$
[Securing a habitable planet is the Alliance's long-held dream. With this much water and air... This could be a new base to replace 《$$アヴァロン$$》.]

63:t_1:38.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Advisory. I infer that this judgment exceeds your authority.]

63:t_1:39.en:
$$レド$$
[Heh... You're right. ...Any progress on contacting the Alliance?]

63:t_1:40.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I continue to transmit distress signals, with no response. If we keep operating alone without essential supplies, your metabolism will be impaired.]

63:t_1:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Recommended course of action 3. You should also consider leaving this environment and returning to artificial hibernation...]

63:t_1:42.en:
$$レド$$
[Wait, $$チェインバー#pilot$$...! Someone's coming.]

63:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I detect no weapons. I infer they are negotiators.]

63:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
[You've finished analyzing their language, right? Tell them we mean no harm.]

63:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We mean no harm.」

63:t_1:49.en:
$$キャシー$$
「As Warrant Officer $$ルカ$$ suspected, it appears to be some kind of support AI.」

63:t_1:50.en:
$$リジット$$
「Well, if we can communicate with it, we should be able to work something out...」

63:t_1:51.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I repeat. We mean no harm.」

63:t_1:52.en:
$$リジット$$
「I am $$リジット$$, aide to this fleet's commander. This is our associate, Lieutenant $$キャサリン・グラス$$. We are here to talk.」

63:t_1:53.en:
$$リジット$$
「Answer our questions. Who are you?」

63:t_1:54.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[They request your name and affiliation.]

63:t_1:56.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, pilot of $$チェインバー#robot$$, a weapon designed to annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

63:t_1:57.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign... So he's a soldier...」

63:t_1:58.en:
$$リジット$$
「What are the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$?」

63:t_1:59.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「They are our enemy... Coexistence is impossible.」

63:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「You are to join the $$人類銀河同盟$$. We request a dialogue. Who is your commander?」

63:t_1:61.en:
$$リジット$$
「...What should we do, $$キャシー$$?」

63:t_1:62.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We've confirmed he means no harm, but his civilization and way of life differ from ours. Our common sense and assumptions may not make sense to each other.」

63:t_1:63.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I think we should first follow the principles of communication between civilizations and look for common ground.」

63:t_1:66.en:
$$キャシー$$
「As $$ガロード$$ reported, there are some differences in his inflections and grammar, but he does seem able to speak Standard Earth Language.」

63:t_1:67.en:
$$キャシー$$
「With time, we should be able to communicate with him directly.」

63:t_1:69.en:
$$リジット$$
「$$エイミー$$...! What on earth are you...?!」

63:t_1:70.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What do you mean...? I brought that boy breakfast.」

63:t_1:71.en:
$$リジット$$
「Wait, $$エイミー$$! We haven't confirmed it's safe yet...」

63:t_1:72.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's fine. If he were going to do anything bad, he'd have done it already.」

63:t_1:74.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good morning. Um... This is breakfast. It's dried horse mackerel.」

63:t_1:75.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is the carcass of an aquatic life-form.]

63:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
[A carcass?! What am I supposed to do with it?!]

63:t_1:77.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I infer it is food.]

63:t_1:78.en:
$$レド$$
[Don't tell me they want me to eat it...!]

63:t_1:79.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I infer this is a ritual of friendship.]

63:t_1:81.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I leave the decision to you.]

63:t_1:85.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I'm $$エイミー$$. Thank you for helping the fleet yesterday.」

63:t_1:18: pirate trails off awaiting Lukkage's decision.
63:t_1:69 and 63:t_1:71: Ridget is interrupted by Amy.

63:t_1:52: representative aide rendered aide to fleet commander for the established administrative role.
63:t_1:66: standard Earth language retained as an in-universe descriptive term.
